scripts.reset-db: node -e "import fs from 'fs'; import { fileURLToPath } from 'url'; import { dirname, join } from 'path'; const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)); const db = join(__dirname, 'handall.db'); if (fs.existsSync(db)) { fs.unlinkSync(db); console.log('Database deleted.'); } else { console.log('Database not found.'); }"
